title: How to (Accidentally) Survive the Islamabad Rishta Market. Tip #1
body: She is 25 and the questions have started at every gathering from people with no other material. Nobody asks the men. The men are asked what they do. She is asked when. It's a sealed deal if she has a prepared answer she has now used eleven times, delivered with a smile that does not move.
caption:
Tip #1 😭 rishta season is undefeated.

title: How to (Accidentally) Survive the Islamabad Rishta Market. Tip #2
body: Watch the biodata machinery, because it starts long before anyone visits. Somebody's khala knows somebody's phupo. Research has happened. An Instagram profile has been examined very carefully and reported to a committee. By the time the tea is poured both sides know more than either will admit. It's a sealed deal if a relative has produced a photo on a phone and said only "dekho."
caption:
Tip #2 😭 rishta season is undefeated.

title: How to (Accidentally) Survive the Islamabad Rishta Market. Tip #3
body: Listen to what's actually being asked in the first ten minutes. The words are about traffic and the weather. The information being gathered is family, job, house or no house, and whether the mother is difficult. Everyone is running the same audit simultaneously. It's a sealed deal if the tea was poured by the youngest woman present and everyone watched exactly how she did it.
caption:
Tip #3 😭 rishta season is undefeated.

title: How to (Accidentally) Survive the Islamabad Rishta Market. Tip #4
body: Ask about the house, because it decides more than anyone will say out loud. Whether the couple lives with his parents is the single biggest question in the negotiation and it gets discussed in code for weeks. "Alag" means one thing. Silence means another. It's a sealed deal if a family has argued for a month about a flat in a building that is not built yet.
caption:
Tip #4 😭 rishta season is undefeated.

title: How to (Accidentally) Survive the Islamabad Rishta Market. Tip #5
body: Watch the sisters, because the order is a timer. Traditionally the older goes first, so if she is 29 and the younger one has something serious, the entire family is in a quiet negotiation nobody named. Both sisters know. Neither will raise it. It's a sealed deal if the younger one has paused her own plans for a year and never once said why.
caption:
Tip #5 😭 rishta season is undefeated.

title: How to (Accidentally) Survive the Islamabad Rishta Market. Tip #6
body: Ask what she actually wants and see how fast the honest answer comes. Not the list she gives relatives. The real one is usually two things: someone whose mother she can survive, and someone who won't be embarrassed by her job. It's a sealed deal if she has refused a perfectly acceptable proposal over one sentence he said about her working.
caption:
Tip #6 😭 rishta season is undefeated.

title: How to (Accidentally) Survive the Islamabad Rishta Market. Tip #7
body: Watch the cousins' group chat, because that's where the real decisions happen. The parents believe they are running this. The cousins have already vetoed two and promoted one. Information moves faster there than through the entire rishta apparatus. It's a sealed deal if a proposal has quietly died because of a screenshot.
caption:
Tip #7 😭 rishta season is undefeated.
